expected_pipeline_outputs._doc: What the Castor pipeline SHOULD produce, derived from the references above. Bands are intentionally wide because the venture description allows multiple defensible scoping interpretations (broad corporate wellness vs narrow employer-sponsored digital MH point-solution).
expected_pipeline_outputs._tam_note: Defensible scoping range: narrow ICP-fit slice (employer-sponsored CBT-I sleep coaching only, ~$500M-$2B), mid-narrow (digital MH employer point-solutions, $2-8B), or broad (US corporate wellness total $20-25B). Pipeline TAM mid acceptable in $0.5B-$25B range as long as 3 methods reconcile.
expected_pipeline_outputs._cagr_note: Grand View 3.1% for total corporate wellness; digital-MH/therapeutics subsegment trades 15-25% in funding-implied growth. Acceptable 3-25%.
expected_pipeline_outputs._competitor_note: KFF explicitly names Headspace and Lyra as third-party EAP vendors. Pipeline should surface these.
